steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In November 2025, a guest on Equity Mates pointed to Chifley, owned by Charter Hall and GIC, as a fantastic building and a trophy-grade asset, underscoring Charter Hall’s presence in high-quality office properties.

episode.title: The $20 billion commercial property investor - Jason Huljich | Centuria Capital

views.text: In April 2025, a guest on Equity Mates described Chifley Tower, co-owned by Charter Hall and Singapore’s government, as a prime CBD asset with extensive amenity, record rents and very high occupancy, and noted Charter Hall was adding a second tower, highlighting the quality of its assets.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In April 2025, Equity Mates said Charter Hall returned 13% a year on average over the past 10 years, using it to illustrate that listed property groups can deliver strong long-term outcomes.
